trap.label: his × her
trap.why: Em português "seu/sua" concorda com a coisa possuída; em inglês his/her concordam com o possuidor (quem tem).

mcq.q: You have a pen. It is ___ pen.

fix.wrong: Ana is my friend. His name is Ana.
fix.right: Ana is my friend. Her name is Ana.

rewrite.prompt: Troque o possessivo: “This is Tom’s book.” (use his)
Reescreva com her: “This is Ana’s bag.”
Reescreva com your: “This is the book of you.”
